newsitem.title: INDIA: India HAL to supply aircraft parts to Boeing.
newsitem.headline: India HAL to supply aircraft parts to Boeing.

text.p: India's state-run aircraft manufacturer Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) said on Thursday it had signed a $22-million agreement to supply aircraft parts to Boeing Co of the U.S..

R.N. Sharma, chairman and managing director of the firm, told reporters in the southern city of Bangalore that HAL would supply various parts and components to Boeing for a period of over three years beginning 1997.
"We have the order in hand...the project includes software and structural parts for aircraft's like Boeing 737 and 747," Sharma said.
HAL was probing the possibility of manufacturing a 100-seat aircraft in collaboration with leading aircraft makers, he said.
"A feasibility study is on to indicate the likely partner. The report will be ready by next month," Sharma said.
HAL announced a profit of 1.05 billion rupees for the year 1996/97 (April-March).
